typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BeginDt as timestamp (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	EndDt as timestamp (),
	Member_Contact_Filename as string (),
	Rootpath as string ()
}

source(output(
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		CITY as string,
		ZIP_CODE as string,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER as string,
		PHONE as string,
		PRODUCT_FLAG as string,
		STATE as string,
		ALTERNATE_PHONE as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		ADDRESS_1 as string,
		ADDRESS_2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT  DISTINCT 	 [PRODUCT_FLAG] 	,[PATIENT_IDENTIFIER] 	,[MEMBER_NAME] 	,CASE 		WHEN [SCRUBBED] = \'Y\' THEN \'\' 		ELSE [PHONE]  	 END AS [PHONE] 	,[ALTERNATE_PHONE] 	,[EMAIL] 	,[ADDRESS_1] 	,[ADDRESS_2] 	,[CITY] 	,[STATE] 	,[ZIP_CODE]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].[EXTRACT].[TN_MONOGRAM_STAGING_ANTHEM_MEMBERCONTACT]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> TNMONOGRAMANTHEMMEMBERCONTACT
TNMONOGRAMANTHEMMEMBERCONTACT sink(input(
		MEMBER_NAME as string,
		CITY as string,
		ZIP_CODE as string,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER as string,
		PHONE as string,
		PRODUCT_FLAG as string,
		STATE as string,
		ALTERNATE_PHONE as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		ADDRESS_1 as string,
		ADDRESS_2 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		MEMBER_NAME,
		CITY,
		ZIP_CODE,
		PATIENT_IDENTIFIER,
		PHONE,
		PRODUCT_FLAG,
		STATE,
		ALTERNATE_PHONE,
		EMAIL,
		ADDRESS_1,
		ADDRESS_2)) ~> FlatFileDestination1
